def factor_volume_amplified_momentum(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    momentum = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(20) - 1
    vol_ratio = df_copy["volume"] / df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=1).mean()
    vol_ratio = vol_ratio.clip(0.5, 2.0)
    df_copy["factor_volume_amplified_momentum"] = momentum * vol_ratio
    return df_copy["factor_volume_amplified_momentum"]
description: Price momentum is confirmed by volume: high momentum with high volume indicates stronger conviction, while low volume momentum may be noise. The factor multiplies raw 20-day momentum by the volume ratio relative to its 20-day average, emphasizing moves that are supported by volume. Clipping the volume ratio prevents extreme values.
